description: This file defines a Kivy application with a GUI for managing a list of items using a RecycleView. It includes UI layout in KV language, class definitions for the app and layout, and methods for populating, sorting, inserting, updating, and removing list items.

classes.name: Test
classes.description: A BoxLayout subclass managing a list of items with methods to populate, sort, clear, insert, update, and remove items in the RecycleView.

classes.name: TestApp
classes.description: An App subclass that builds and runs the Kivy application.

methods.name: populate
methods.description: Fills the RecycleView data with 50 randomly generated items.

methods.name: sort
methods.description: Sorts the RecycleView data by the 'name.text' field.

methods.name: insert
methods.description: Inserts a new item at the beginning of the list with the given value.

methods.name: update
methods.description: Updates the first item's 'name.text' with the given value.

methods.name: remove
methods.description: Removes the first item from the list.

methods.name: build
methods.description: Builds the UI layout for the app.
